system.description:
You strike your foe into the air before quickly following up with a strike to slam them down. A target creature in range must make a Strength Saving Throw, taking your [Weapons damage] + 4d6 and are thrown 20 feet into the air on a failure or half as much on a success.

If launched airborne, you can make a follow up melee Taijutsu attack at advantage against the same creature, dealing your [Weapons damage] + 4d6 and inflicting the Bruised conditionas they fall Prone.

Chain 2: Creatures Prone as a result of this jutsu must spend their full movement to stand. At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this above B-Rank, increase the cost by 3. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you can instead force all creatures in weapons range to make the Strength Saving Throw. You still only make a single attack but compare the result to each creatures AC.
